relationships.note: Two halves of the same defence. A vision is not a prophecy so the false-prophet test does not apply, and it is given to be prayed against so an absent outcome is a success.
The category is narrowed and then the accuracy standard within it is narrowed too: a vision rather than a prophecy, and the sentences rather than the street address.
They maintain their own index of the words, which is what makes the on-air replays possible and the accuracy claim checkable.
The Lord is quoted saying you will not stop it, only lessen it. That removes the prayer escape from this particular claim, against the frame that a sight is given to be prayed away.
